title: If saving the display fails, the old one stays and you can retry
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. Board View currently saved as the preference; ability to force the preference save to fail.
custom_steps:
1. With saves forced to fail, switch to Tech View.
  2. Confirm you can still switch displays.
  3. Retry the save.
  4. Reload the page and observe which preference was retained.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • If saving your display preference fails, your previously saved preference is kept.
  • A failed preference save does not stop you switching displays or trying the save again.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10044 — Story 1 Switch between display options. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options (Draft Spec)”, Draft v0.9, requirement(s) S1-N3, S1-N4 (read 23 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-N3: “A failed preference save retains the previously saved preference.”
  • S1-N4: “A failed preference save does not prevent view switching or retrying the save.”
